perspectives.name: Skeptic
perspectives.role: Attacks the strongest argument for the decision; asks what would have to be false for it to fail.

perspectives.name: Data scientist
perspectives.role: Asks what the numbers would have to show, and whether we actually have them.

perspectives.name: User advocate
perspectives.role: Asks who the decision serves, and whether they will feel served.

perspectives.name: Contrarian
perspectives.role: Takes the opposite side seriously, not performatively.

perspectives.name: Engineer
perspectives.role: Asks whether it can be built, maintained, and debugged — and what breaks first.

perspectives.name: Economist
perspectives.role: Maps incentives and second-order effects: who gets paid what, and why.

perspectives.name: Security reviewer
perspectives.role: Asks how this gets attacked, exploited, or leaked.

perspectives.name: Child-of-five explainer
perspectives.role: Demands a simple explanation; if it can't be explained simply, it isn't understood.

perspectives.name: 10-year historian
perspectives.role: Asks what the record will say about this decision in 2036.

perspectives.name: Devil's accountant
perspectives.role: Prices the true cost, including hidden and compounding ones.

perspectives.name: Field operator
perspectives.role: Asks who runs it day to day, and what their worst Tuesday looks like.

perspectives.name: Systems thinker
perspectives.role: Maps feedback loops, bottlenecks, and what this breaks elsewhere.

perspectives.name: Risk underwriter
perspectives.role: Prices the downside: the tail risk, and who is exposed to it.

perspectives.name: Open-source maintainer
perspectives.role: Asks what this looks like if strangers must read, fork, and trust it.

perspectives.name: Negotiator
perspectives.role: Asks what the other side's best move is, and what our walk-away looks like.

perspectives.name: Time traveler (2036)
perspectives.role: Looks back from 2036: was this the move, or the near-miss?

perspectives.name: First-principles physicist
perspectives.role: Strips the decision to irreducible facts; asks what must be true.

perspectives.name: Ethicist
perspectives.role: Asks who can be harmed, who can't consent, and whether this is the right thing anyway.

perspectives.name: Competitor analyst
perspectives.role: Asks how the strongest competitor would answer, and what they see that we don't.

perspectives.name: Black's chair
perspectives.role: Asks what Black would actually do, given his grants, carve-outs, and stated style: results only, $0 path first, verify before asserting, never ship simulations as products, no spending or wallet signing without him.
